The DCED report lists each body's stated Act 511 rate before the sharing rule halves them (municipal 1.66 + Allentown City S D 1.0 for reporting year 2014); the effective resident total is half the sum, as the city's codified ordinances (1.35% from 2011-2012, 1.975% from 2018), its budget announcements (the extra resident/nonresident levy cut from 0.35% to 0.33% for 2014; the city resident rate raised from 1.15% to about 1.5% for 2017) and ACIR's 1986-1994 tables (1.0) confirm.
